uniteDbPokemon.notes: Unite-DB public pokemon.json. v3 enumerates skills, boosted basic attacks, nested upgrade choices, Plus/enhanced effects, Unite Moves, and Unite Buffs.

sourceList.originalDescription: When the Pokémon uses a move, their movement speed increases by 30% for 3s. Each time this Pokémon knocks out an opposing Pokémon, scores a goal, or otherwise makes a contribution in battle, their effort gauge increases. Once the gauge is full, the Pokémon evolves into Gyarados.
Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing increased damage. Magikarp and Mega Evolved Gyarados do not have a boosted attack. Mega Evolved Gyarados lunges when using a basic attack.
No English description available in Unite-DB JSON.
Flails on the spot, damaging nearby opposing Pokémon; damage strengthens for every 33% max HP the user is missing.

Exhales a mighty gust in the designated direction, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and paralyzing them for 3s when it hits, decreasing their movement speed and basic attack speed by 30%. If this move hits, gains a buff for 5s; increasing the range and damage of auto attacks; and increasing basic attack speed by a minimum of 30%, strengthening by 10% for each additional opposing Pokémon hit (up to 2 times; maximum 50%). If the user is mega evolved, instead Mega Gyarados becomes unstoppable then chases down and performs 5 special auto attacks on targets hit by this attack.
Increases the damage dealt by this move and basic attacks.
Jumps to the designated location forward. A maximum of 3 uses can be kept in reserve, with a 2s cooldown between uses.

Charges forward up to 3 times, damaging opposing Pokémon hit with each charge; waiting for at least 0.07s before dashing forward with the next charge. The first charge is a regular dash forward; the next movement within 2s after the last charge dashes forward with the same effect. Dragon Breath can be used within the 2s duration in between charges without interrupting this move's course. Using Dragon Current ends this move early. This move's cooldown begins when the move ends. If two charges hit opposing Pokémon, grants a shield for 2s. If all three charges hit opposing Pokémon, the third charge throws opposing Pokémon hit for 0.45s. If the user is mega evolved, instead the cooldown begins when the move is used. Additionally, the previous shield and throw effects are granted even if the move misses, and the cooldown of the move is reduced by 10% for each dash that hits.

Becomes untargetable and dives underwater for up to 4s while this Unite Move is held, increasing movement speed by 45%. When the button is released, the user leaps up forcefully and attacks. If the user stays underwater for 1s, Gyarados strengthens the movement speed increase to 55% and creates a whirlpool when surfacing, applying a continuous slow to opposing Pokémon hit. If the user stays underwater for 2s, Gyarados strengthens the movement speed increase to 65% and creates a waterspout when surfacing, throwing opposing Pokémon hit for 1s. The longer the move is held, the larger the area of effect becomes. After using this Unite Move, the user Mega Evolves for 15 seconds.
Buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield Buff duration: 6
